title: cerastium semidecandrum subsp. macilentum
intro: Cerastium semidecandrum subsp. macilentum, commonly known as the Alpine Chickweed or Alpine Snow-in-summit, is a type of flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium semidecandrum subsp. macilentum include soothing irritated tissues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
